title: 初始化沙箱 Git 仓库
summary: 在指定目录准备工作树、HTTPS origin、仓库本地凭证和提交身份。
description: Use project_repo_id returned by git_repo.list. Paths may be absolute or relative to the session CWD. Each call sets the repository-local Git name and email from the sandbox execution account. An unverified email is accepted. GIT_EMAIL_REQUIRED means the execution account needs an email. No network fetch or checkout occurs.
result_description: Resolved path, project_repo_id, conn_id, origin and default_branch.
